descriptor: Coastal research lab with an open archive

voice.summary: Skerry Marine Lab writes like a long-serving scientist: precise, patient and a little wry. It states what was recorded and when, and opens its archive without fuss.
dos: Give dates and places for every observation
Use measured verbs: logged, recorded, observed
Invite readers to ask for the archive
donts: Do not use dramatic ocean language
Never close the archive behind a form

taglines: An open archive of the coast
Tides, divers and decades of data
Ask us what the water did
boilerplate: Skerry Marine Lab has logged every season on one stretch of coast since 1987 using divers and tide gauges, and keeps the full archive open to anyone who asks.

logo.note: A wave is a simple, honest mark for a tide-focused lab and sits calmly on sea-glass.
